content.text: Customized Experiences for Personal Transformation in
Kauai, Hawaii
EMBARK ON A journey
OF SELF DISCOVERY, AND TRANSFORMATION
These customized five-day intimate and immersive retreats are designed to guide you into
deeper alignment with your true self and illuminate pathways to a life filled with devotion, purpose, and fulfillment.
This container is a sacred space to nurture your connection with yourself and tend to your inner world so you can LEAD the next chapter of your life with
greater love, clarity, freedom, and vitality.

Whether you're entangled in the responsibilities of entrepreneurship, navigating a life transition, seeking clarity, or feeling stuck, your customized transformative retreat will offer a respite from the daily grind.
Our five days together are
entirely devoted to your personal evolution
, weaving a harmonious blend of guided embodiment practices, healing sessions, glorious island adventures, rituals, mind-body-spirit rejuvenation, creative exploration, and leadership cultivation.
The Garden Isle

Our immersions are held in the mystical and powerful healing island of Kauai. I have deep respect, love, appreciation, and devotion to this sacred land. Of all the places I have traveled in the world, Kauai has touched my heart most deeply. I have experienced extraordinary depths of transformation and healing living here over the years.

This island is powerful, loving, and fierce. Her boundless beauty, awe-inspiring wonders, and healing energy are impeccably pure, carrying a high frequency of unconditional love that is a palpable emanation of the divine mother. You can't help but restore more connection to yourself, the earth, and the living wisdom of life through being here.
As we journey, part of your experience will be working with the elements, listening to your heart, the land, and your soul's wisdom.

Although each experience is customized, water rituals, fire ceremonies, and offerings to the earth are woven into each immersion. We will be practicing reciprocity in giving back to the land as it gives to you. ​
Craft Your Unique Journey
WITH CURATED TRANSFORMATIVE EXPERIENCES INCLUDING:
Intuitive Healing Sessions, Vocal Empowerment, Personalized Guided Meditations, Tea Ceremony, Breathwork, Sound Healing, Mushroom Ceremony, Nature Excursions, Leadership
Attunements, Embodiment Practices, and Rituals.
Intuitive Healing
These deep healing sessions allow layers of protection to dissolve and welcome the power of your heart to bring forth transformation at cellular, mental, physical, and energetic levels.
Tea Ceremony

Experience the beauty of Tea ceremonies to welcome stillness, contemplation, and gentle healing. In this practice, each gesture and moment engenders an opportunity to embrace presence and elevate the ordinary into an extraordinary pause for the soul.
Vocal Empowerment

Experience creative exploration and activate the power of your voice through poetry, creative writing practices, toning, and song. Deepening your connection to the incredible healing power of your own voice.
Island Experiences

The Island of Kauai herself is a portal that initiates profound transformation. I will guide your experience to commune with her crystalline ocean, sacred sites, majestic mountains, and enchanting rivers, activating your expanding heart with her unconditional love.
​Ritual
Rituals are gateways to the heart of now. They provide moments
of intention that nourish deeper meaning and connection to the sacred. Rituals will be woven all throughout the immersion, deepening your experience with love, beauty, the earth, and all of life.
Embodiment Practices

Experience heightened awareness, and inner peace through deepening your connection with your body's innate intelligence. Through chi gong, intuitive movement, journaling, song, meditation, prayer, and breathwork.
Miracles will unfold, and magic will permeate.
The liberation of what no longer serves will pave a pathway for revelations and quantum shifts.
A peak into the possibly
Where you'll be staying

You will be welcomed to my home, the "Heart Temple." A radiant sanctuary surrounded by the vibrant nature of Kauai. A magical oasis filled with wild birds, blooming flowers, and fruit trees. You'll enjoy majestic mountain views with cascading waterfalls, exclusive access to our private saltwater pool and jacuzzi, and the ocean within a scenic ten-minute drive.
As part of your experience, you will have plenty of time to rest, nurture yourself, integrate, and connect with the beauty of the land.
Whats Included
Your immersion includes luxurious accommodation, three delicious meals a day, beautiful adventures, powerful ceremonies, and personalized transformative session work.
All you need to do is show up with an open heart, a curiosity to create change in your life and embrace the love, beauty, and miracles that await you.
YOUR
INVESTMENT
A TRANSFORMATIONAL 5-DAY IMMERSION BEGINS AT $3,500
Custom options are available upon request for those seeking shorter or extended experiences or if you want to have your immersion with a partner or friend.​​​
Please feel free to reach out for any inquiries or to discuss other personalized options.
It would be a deep honor and joy to co-create your immersion!
With Love,
Courtney
What clients are saying

“I had a week-long immersion with Courtney and experienced one of the most beautiful weeks of my life. The flow, grace, power, magic, and healing was beyond any expectation. It was pure spirit working through. The way Courtney weaves her intuition with inner child healing, movement, song, ceremony, trauma healing, adventure, and play is mind-blowing. I feel the integration and return of lost pieces of my soul. There was so much clearing of past guilt, shame, and patterns of shutting down. This was the safest container to open, surrender, trust, and unravel. I feel whole, like I've stepped into a new self.”
- Hypnotherapist, Ceremonial Guide
​Mariana Grace
A Little About Me...
My Journey

My path into healing arts began at a very young age, developing my psychic abilities, compassion, and sensitivities through intense hardship. By the time I was in my late teens, I manifested several physical accidents that resulted in multiple surgeries and severe spinal issues causing unbearable pain.
This was the very catalyst to launch me passionately onto my path of seeking modalities that would liberate me from my physical and emotional suffering.

I've now traveled the world studying a variety of powerful transformational tools and healing modalities in diverse ranges of teachings and ancient wisdom traditions. Ranging from yoga of the voice, ancestral healing, NLP, internal family systems, energy healing, chi gong, tao tantra, improv, meditation, plant medicine, yin yoga, sound healing, and women's circle facilitation. My passion is helping others liberate themselves from suffering, turn their pain into power, and create a life they are in absolutely love with.
